method: Built-in image_gen, using the supplied photograph as a visual reference. The generated files contain only flat screen artwork, not photographs of the hall or its architecture.

assets.content: One navy orb and one thin champagne portal over a reflective blue alpine lake. No text or reception architecture.
Portrait electric-blue and champagne fine light filaments on navy, with open upper-middle area for runtime identity. No text or cylinder geometry.
Horizontal electric-blue and champagne filaments, with open central-right navy field. No text or counter/halo geometry.

processing: Original generated PNGs preserved. Runtime WebP siblings encoded by Sharp quality 94, effort 6.
acceptance: These are reference-guided reconstructions of the displayed artwork. They are not represented as pixel-identical copies of the reference. Architecture, furniture, people and branding are separate actual 3D/runtime objects.
